verdict.rationale: The gateway offers a few narrow, configurable triggers: per-provider timeouts that cause fast failover, provider order/only rules that decide where requests fail over, and budgets that cap spend at set limits. These are fixed, built-in reactions within the routing domain, not a general facility for user-defined event-to-action rules. Missing for 10: general user-defined rules or automations, webhooks or notifications on events, custom actions beyond failover and spend caps, and any independent corroboration.
